description: Invoke the existing /decide service: five Jev jurors over a frozen capsule, with persisted signed receipt. Without payment returns the fresh x402 challenge. Requires caller Jev key in X-JEV-API-KEY and a caller-created PAYMENT-SIGNATURE header or payment_signature argument. Never creates a wallet signature or submits trades. model_spend_authorized=true is required before paid execution. Paid: $0.25 USDC via x402 on Base.

capsule.description: The decision capsule to submit for a paid verdict — the same capsule shape verdict_compile_capsule accepts: instrument, regime, thesis, support, contradiction, execution, and optional metadata.

model_spend_authorized.description: Must be true: the caller's explicit authorization to spend on the paid Jev jury evaluation. Paid execution is refused without it.

payment_signature.description: Caller-created x402 PAYMENT-SIGNATURE value for the $0.25 USDC payment on Base; it may instead be sent as the PAYMENT-SIGNATURE HTTP header. Omit it to receive the fresh 402 payment challenge.

name: verdict_decide
title: Run paid BYOK Jev verdict
